title: Pneumatic — Bleed Monitoring — Install the Second Pressure Sensing Path and Widen the Overheat Confirmation
abstract: Installs a second independent pressure sensor in the cross-bleed manifold, replaces the computer input card and applies the widened duct overheat confirmation, so that a single sensor drift no longer commands a bleed shutdown.

sections.planning_reason: On twenty-nine occasions in two years an aircraft continued to destination on a single bleed source because a pressure sensor had drifted, and in every case the removed sensor tested serviceable on the bench. The duct overheat confirmation window was also short enough that a normal transient during engine acceleration could trip it on aircraft with the higher bleed pressure schedule. Dispatch reliability for the pneumatic system had fallen below the level the programme is prepared to defend, and the affected operators were carrying the consequences on every rotation.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to install a second pressure sensor in the cross-bleed manifold, wired to a separate input of the bleed monitoring computer, and to replace the computer input card so that the additional channel is available. The manifold duct is replaced by an item carrying the second sensor boss, the temperature sensor is renewed and the clamp set is replaced at every position because the duct wall thickness changes locally. After the hardware change the widened overheat confirmation and the sensor disagreement logic are applied through the operational and built-in test loads.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Depressurise the pneumatic system and open the wing root fairing. Remove the existing cross-bleed manifold duct and the temperature sensor. Install the replacement duct with the second sensor boss, using new clamps at every position. Install both pressure sensors and the renewed temperature sensor. Route and terminate the new sensor harness between the two rack positions, and re-terminate at the computer. Remove the bleed monitoring computer and replace the input card, then reinstall using AMM-T-36-20-11-400-003-A. Restore pneumatic pressure and check the manifold for leaks at the working pressure given in the task. Load the operational and built-in test software and confirm the part numbers. Do the bleed system functional test and confirm that a simulated single sensor drift produces a maintenance message and not a shutdown. Close the fairing. Record the modification and update the configuration record.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CVX-7270 powered TITAN-88 aircraft in the MSN T00014 to T00186 range, excluding MSN T00089 which carries a non-standard manifold. Auran powered aircraft run a different bleed pressure schedule and are not affected by the confirmation window issue; they are outside this effectivity.
sections.material_note: Kit K3620-1009-01 covers one aircraft, both sides. The cross-bleed manifold duct is the long-lead item at twenty-six weeks and should be ordered against a planned slot. The removed duct is returned for material recovery.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 42 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
